description: This file defines the IQueueCacheCursor interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which enumerates messages in a stream, providing methods to get current messages, navigate through the stream, refresh the cursor, and record delivery failures.

classes.name: IQueueCacheCursor
classes.description: Interface for enumerating messages in a stream, including methods for navigation, retrieval, refresh, and failure recording.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current batch container and any associated exception.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the stream.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor's state when new data is added into the cache.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Records a delivery failure event for the current message.
